title: The trusted consultant needs OAuth access
scenario: A consultant you have worked with for a year says their reporting tool was upgraded and asks you to reconnect your company account. The consent screen now requests broader permissions than before.

answers.A: Ask for vendor documentation explaining the permission change and whether a least-privilege option exists.
answers.B: Approve because the consultant and tool are already trusted vendors.
answers.C: Pause and verify the new permission scope with the consultant and internal IT/security before reauthorizing.

explanation: Trusted vendors can change, be compromised, or request excessive permissions. Prior trust does not automatically extend to new access.
proTip: Old vendor, new permissions = new decision.
